prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Choose Your Pet Companion Path", "Select how you would like to create your desktop companion.", "Path Options"]
1: ["Signing in ensures your pet data is safely backed up to the cloud and restored anytime.", "Create or sign in to your account to securely store your pet's progress and custom appearance."]
2: ["Select your favorite pet companion before customizing their personality and name."]
3: ["Preparing Your Desktop Companion", "Rendering pet model...", "Desktop Tips"]
4: ["Your Desktop Companion is Ready!", "Learn how to summon, interact with, or hide your desktop pet using quick controls.", "Quick Controls Overview"]
5: ["Connecting to secure authentication service... Please wait a moment."]
6: ["Official Companion Certificate"]
7: ["Your pet is being generated. You can minimize this window and we will notify you when ready."]
8: ["Starter Pack Unlocked!", "Includes starter treats and desktop toys."]
9: ["Setup takes about 2-3 minutes. Choose your companion creation path to begin!"]

verdicts.problem: Mentions unlocked starter packs and free extras.
